topics.title: Alberta rejects separation referendum plan
topics.summary: Alberta voters rejected a proposed referendum on leaving Canada, according to a CBC projection reported by multiple outlets.
topics.discussionPrompt: A province-wide vote can make a whole country pause. What local issue do you think people would actually enjoy debating over coffee instead of online?

topics.title: Jio prepares India’s biggest-ever IPO
topics.summary: Mukesh Ambani’s Jio Platforms is preparing a public listing that would be India’s largest, with a reported valuation target of about £81 billion.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a familiar service becomes a giant public company, does it feel exciting, distant, or mostly like something you notice only when the app changes?

topics.title: Bradford plans a new railway station
topics.summary: Plans for a new station in Bradford are being presented as a way to improve rail connections and reshape travel across northern England.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your town got one perfect transport upgrade tomorrow, would you pick a train station, bike lanes, late buses, a tram, or teleportation booths?

topics.title: Royal Exchange unveils its new theatre season
topics.summary: Manchester’s Royal Exchange has announced a new season, including a Stockport-set reworking of the Phaedra myth by playwright Simon Stephens.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which ancient story deserves a modern version set somewhere ordinary: a grocery store, an apartment building, a bus route, or a very dramatic group chat?

topics.title: David Bowie inspires a new dance show
topics.summary: A new dance production will reinterpret David Bowie’s music and alter egos, exploring the performer’s knack for artistic reinvention.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you had to invent a stage alter ego for one evening, what would their name, outfit, and completely unnecessary special power be?

topics.title: World Series guarantees a first-time champion
topics.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers have set up a World Series matchup, ensuring the championship will go to a first-time winner.
topics.discussionPrompt: Do you cheer for the underdog, the team with the best snacks, or whichever side has a mascot you could imagine inviting to dinner?

topics.title: Europe’s wild bees face mounting pressure
topics.summary: A new assessment says many of Europe’s wild bee species are in decline, renewing calls for stronger habitat protection and practical conservation.
topics.discussionPrompt: What would make your neighborhood friendlier to pollinators: more flowers, fewer tidy lawns, balcony planters, community gardens, or tiny bee hotels?

topics.title: Air fares could rise in 2027
topics.summary: Ryanair’s chief executive says European air fares could rise by as much as 20% next year, citing industry costs and capacity pressures.
topics.discussionPrompt: When travel gets pricier, what is the first thing you would trade: the destination, the timing, the luggage, the hotel, or the fancy airport coffee?

topics.title: NHS founding principles draw fresh debate
topics.summary: New polling reported by the Guardian suggests public support for the NHS’s founding principles is weakening amid economic pressures and changing attitudes.
topics.discussionPrompt: What public service do you think people notice most when it works quietly in the background: libraries, parks, transit, health care, or something else?

topics.title: Jio listing puts broadband in the spotlight
topics.summary: Jio Platforms’ planned public offering has renewed attention on low-cost broadband and how access to fast internet can shape everyday life.
topics.discussionPrompt: If fast, reliable internet suddenly became free everywhere, what would change first in your day: work, learning, gaming, calling family, or binge-watching?
